# Dashboard & Docking's catalog cards get their Engine 14 covers

## Context

#21146 (covers in bulk) closed into the group lanes, and #21316 closed unmerged, so each group lane of #21140 publishes its own covers. Dashboard & Docking is mine. `Portal.model.Example.publishes()` (`apps/portal/model/Example.mjs:133`) publishes a card only for a record that names an `image`. Two of the group's three standing records name none, so the group shows one card, choreography's 13.2 cover. #21340 (Resolves #21323) repoints `dock-layouts` to the operations desk; its AC-6 hands that cover to this ticket.

## The Problem

| Record | Stage | `image` today |
|---|---|---|
| `dock-layouts` | `examples/dashboard/desk` (#21340) | `null` |
| `dock-cross-window` | `examples/dashboard/crossWindow`, a keep | `null` |
| `dock-choreography` | choreography, a keep | `devmode/dock-choreography-13-2.jpg` |

## The Architectural Reality

- `buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs` reads `apps/portal/resources/data/example-captures.json` (families `grid-table`, `gantt` and `scheduler`; suffix `14`; since #21342 also `tiles`). It runs each recipe's `ready`, `steps` and `after` selectors and writes `devmode/<id>-14.jpg`.
- The validator requires a recipe for every record of a declared family that names an image (`captureExamples.mjs:151`). Declaring `dashboard` therefore needs a choreography recipe even if its 13.2 cover stays. The four `dock-*` records already carry `family: 'dashboard'`; `dock-tear-out` names no image, so it needs none.
- The bytes are served from `neomjs/pages` (`resources_pub/website/examples/devmode/`). A record's `image` names its file, and `publishes()` is true once it does: `dock-layouts` already lists a URL for each of the four build modes. Siblings: the Gantt and Scheduler covers (#21121) and #21328 with pages #108.

## The Fix

1. `example-captures.json`: the `dashboard` family, with recipes for `dock-layouts` (the desk's first frame), `dock-cross-window` and `dock-choreography` (its first frame, which its 13.2 cover shows).
2. Capture at the recipe viewports, then one `neomjs/pages` pull request with the bytes.
3. `examples.json`: each record names its `devmode/<id>-14.jpg`. Choreography keeps its 13.2 file or takes the new one, and the pull request says which.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `example-captures.json` declares the `dashboard` family with the three recipes, and `node buildScripts/docs/captureExamples.mjs --family dashboard` passes their `ready` and `after` checks.
- [ ] AC-2: The bytes are on `neomjs/pages` `main`, and each record names its file.
- [ ] AC-3: `publishes()` is true for all three in every build mode they list. The Dashboard & Docking group shows three cards, and the pull request carries the group page's frame.

## Out of Scope

`dock-tear-out`'s cover: its renewal writes it. The sortable dashboard's cover: its own pull request writes it. Changes to `captureExamples.mjs`.
